pass_a_gloss: §20 dual gloss (Armenian-via-French sense) ≠ Pass B running English. Theme: Ham cursed; Shem and Japheth blessed; Gentile calling foreshadowed.
pass_b_english: But one of them fell under the stroke of curses; the other two inherited the blessing because of their works. For the younger of them, called Ham, mocked his father; and because of the insult and contempt shown to his father he was condemned for a sin of impiety and cursed, and he made the curses fall back upon all who were born of him: so it came about that all his race after him was cursed, grew, and multiplied in sin. ([[cursed be Canaan >> Bible:Gen 9:22-25]])

On the contrary, Shem and Japheth, his brothers, because of their filial piety toward their father, were loaded with blessings. Now the curse of Ham, launched against him by his father Noah, was this: ‘Cursed be the child of Ham; let him be the servant of his brothers!’ ([[Gen 9:25 >> Bible:Gen 9:25]]) His children had a numerous posterity upon the earth; for fourteen generations it developed in their land, until the day when it was harvested by God, who made it undergo his judgment.

And just as the curse passed on, so also the blessing passed on to the race of him who was blessed, each in his order. For first Shem was blessed in these words: ‘Blessed be the Lord, the God of Shem; and Ham shall be his servant.’ ([[Gen 9:26 >> Bible:Gen 9:26]]) The power of the blessing lies in this — that the God and Lord of all should be to Shem a peculiar possession of worship. And the blessing extended and reached unto Abraham, who was reckoned as descended in the tenth generation from the race of Shem. ([[genealogy Shem to Abram >> Bible:Gen 11:10-26]])

Now the blessing of Japheth is on this wise: ‘God shall enlarge unto Japheth, and he shall dwell in the house of Shem, and Ham shall be his servant.’ ([[Gen 9:27 >> Bible:Gen 9:27]]) That is: at the end of the ages he blossomed forth, at the appearing of the Lord, through the calling of the Gentiles, when God enlarged unto them the calling; and their sound went out into all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. ([[Rom 10:18 >> Bible:Rom 10:18]]; [[Ps 19:4 >> Bible:Ps 19:4]]) The enlarging, then, is the calling from among the Gentiles — that is, the Church — and Japheth’s dwelling in the house of Shem signifies dwelling in the inheritance of the fathers, having received in Jesus Christ the rights of the firstborn. ([[Gentiles … fellow heirs >> Bible:Eph 3:6]]; [[firstborn among many brothers >> Bible:Rom 8:29]])
